description: CSV data insights (grounded) — Upload a CSV and get the insights a manager cares about. Statistics are computed offline first (per-column totals, means, medians, outliers, missing values, top categories, correlations, group breakdowns, first-vs-last trend and peak), then Workers AI explains them. Every number in every insight is checked against the computed facts and flagged if unverified, so the narrative cannot invent figures. Optional: question= to focus the analysis. Up to 5,000 rows. Nothing stored. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_data_insights
